title: Boogu-Image-0.1: Boosting Open-Source Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation
hook: An open recipe for text-to-image, editing, and bilingual text rendering that closes in on closed-source giants — for a reported $400K training budget.
key_points: One model family (Base, Turbo, Edit, Edit-Turbo) covers text-to-image generation, fast inference, instruction-based editing, and Chinese-English text rendering.
Matches or beats other open-source models on standard benchmarks, and approaches leading closed systems like Nano-Banana-Pro and GPT-Image-2.
Trained on only ~208.6 million unique images, with a reported base-model training cost of roughly $400K.
Gains come from better data quality and training pipelines plus agentic inference-time scaling, not just more compute.
Weights, code, and training recipes released under Apache 2.0.
content_html: Closed-source image models like Nano-Banana-Pro and GPT-Image-2 look untouchable partly because nobody outside the lab knows how they're built — the gains come from system-level integration that stays undisclosed. Boogu-Image-0.1 is an attempt to open that recipe back up.
extra_html:
The model family — Base, Turbo, Edit, and Edit-Turbo — handles text-to-image generation, fast inference, instruction-based editing, and bilingual (Chinese-English) text rendering. Guoxuan Chen and a large multi-institution team report that targeted improvements to model understanding, data quality, and training pipelines, combined with agentic inference-time scaling, let them match or beat other open-source models and approach leading closed systems — using only about 208.6 million unique images and a theoretical training cost around $400K for the base model.

The team released weights, code, and training recipes under Apache 2.0, explicitly framing the paper as a set of practical discussions for the open research community rather than just a model drop. Chen and colleagues, arXiv 2026.

related.title: Vision as Unified Multimodal Generation
related.hook: Detection, segmentation, depth, pose — each normally needs its own architecture. This model does all of them as text-and-image generation from one multimodal model, no task-specific heads.

related.title: Nano Banana (Gemini Image)
related.hook: Google's native Gemini image model — nicknamed Nano Banana — made conversational, character-consistent image editing go viral, drawing millions to the Gemini app.

related.title: Qwen-Image-2.0-RL: RLHF for a Diffusion Model
related.hook: Qwen's team applied RLHF and on-policy distillation to a text-to-image diffusion model — the same post-training playbook that shaped chat models, now tuning image generation and editing.

choices.text: Those systems get strong results via system-level integration, while their internal single-model practices stay undisclosed
Closed systems use far less training data than Boogu-Image-0.1
Closed systems can't do instruction-based editing at all

flashcards.explanation_html: The paper frames closed-source strength as coming from undisclosed system-level integration, whereas Boogu-Image-0.1 shares its single-model recipe openly.

flashcards.prompt: What four variants make up the Boogu-Image-0.1 family, and what does each add?
flashcards.back_html: Base (core generation), Turbo (fast inference), Edit (instruction-based editing), and Edit-Turbo (fast editing).
